notes.null_coercion_hazard: update-task.ts:60-61 coerces omitted startDate/dueDate to null. Copying that shape means every full-PUT caller that omits the new field ERASES it -- including the web updateTask fetcher used by drag-and-drop and archive-all, and the MCP read-modify-write at mcp/tools.ts:119-186. The design must choose a guarantee (preserve-on-omit vs explicit-null-to-clear) and pin it with a test that includes a drag-and-drop-shaped update omitting the field.
